remaining.title: The exchange date on the reveal
remaining.why: Not in the fix list (it was a minor persona friction). It needs a new field in the payload, which lengthens every URL and touches the encode/decode contract — the wrong thing to slip in unmeasured alongside thirteen other changes.

remaining.title: #resultsHeading is 24px tall and carries tabindex="-1", so the 44px target scan lists it
remaining.why: It is a focus destination for the post-draw announcement, not a touch target. Inflating a heading to 44px to satisfy the heuristic would be worse design than the false positive; the standard battery's under-32px line stays empty because it never completes a draw.

remaining.title: Pass-the-phone draw mode
remaining.why: A research differentiator, not one of the reviewed fixes, and a third interaction mode is more than this round can verify properly.
